summary: The builder reported that `npm run build` fails and pointed at an npm debug log. That log file does not exist on this machine, and on the current working tree `npm run build` (rollup -c) and `npm run type-check` (tsc --noEmit) both complete without errors, producing dist/index.js and dist/index.mjs. The requirement is therefore that the library's build must finish successfully from a clean state, including with the light/dark/system theme work already decided, so that a developer can publish the package. No new product behaviour is requested.
roles: Library maintainer: runs npm run build to produce the package that is published to npm
Library consumer (developer who installs the package): receives the built output

requirements.text: Running `npm run build` in the library root finishes with exit code 0 and produces dist/index.js, dist/index.mjs and the type declarations, with no errors.
requirements.rationale: The builder reported a failing build. A library that cannot be built cannot be published, so every other change (including the approved theme feature) is blocked until the build is green.
acceptance: From a clean checkout (dist removed, dependencies installed), `npm run build` exits with code 0
dist/index.js and dist/index.mjs exist after the build
`npm test` still passes after any change made to fix the build
edgeCases: The build must pass from a clean state (dist deleted), not only when an old dist folder is already present

If a build error can only be reproduced under conditions other than the current tree (for example a different Node version), the error message and cause must be recorded rather than the build declared fixed without evidence
The theme feature's CSS and TypeScript changes must not introduce build or type errors
pitfalls: Fixing the build must not remove or change any exported component, prop or type
The build must not be made to pass by disabling checks, type-checking or tests

outOfScope: Any new feature or visual change
Creating missing scaffolding such as .size-limit.json, scripts/check-docs.mjs or scripts/consumer-smoke.mjs
Upgrading dependencies beyond what is needed to make the build pass

nonFunctional.statement: The build gives the same result on repeated runs from a clean state.
nonFunctional.acceptance: Running `npm run build` twice in a row from a clean state exits with code 0 both times.

risks: The reported log file is missing, so the original failure cannot be read; it may have been caused by work in progress that has since been changed, or by a different environment.
The working tree has uncommitted changes, so a failure could return if they are reverted or altered.
glossary: Build: `rollup -c`, which bundles src/index.tsx into dist/index.js and dist/index.mjs.

coverage.note: Library maintainer and consumers; the request comes from the builder.
No data is stored; this is a build fix.
No records or access control involved.
The only states are build succeeds or fails with a readable error.
Reliability only: build is repeatable from a clean state.

assumptions: The failure was caused by earlier in-progress work and does not reproduce on the current tree, since `npm run build` and `npm run type-check` pass today; the developer re-verifies from a clean state and fixes anything that still fails.
Success means exit code 0 for build, type-check and tests, not a size budget or docs check, since the project has no scripts for those.
